crossRefs.note: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is…
All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught…
But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled…
Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed…
In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,

For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.
As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes…
Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest came, and those who were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
translations.bsb: At daybreak the apostles entered the temple courts as they had been told and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they convened the Sanhedrin—the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.
translations.kjv: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
translations.asv: And when they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison-house to have them brought.
